answer.summary: Spring ApplicationContext fails to start, so every test that loads it errors out, including the listed AutonomousAttackPathStepOwnershipTest and AutonomousDefaultAgentsNoSelectorCallersTest cases. The cause is an invalid query in PayloadIdentityRepository.findAllActionIdsByTenantIdWithOlderVersionsInUse, which this change touches; JSqlParser rejects it at line 15, column 68 with an unexpected identifier near 'ANDi'. This is deterministic, so a re-run will fail the same way.
